Class ExecutionPolicy

java.lang.Object
app.order.execution.ExecutionPolicy
public final class ExecutionPolicy extends Object
Pure, inclusive stock execution conditions and adverse-price protection, and the hours of the simulated session every instrument trades on: Monday to Friday, SESSION_OPEN to SESSION_CLOSE in MARKET_ZONE.
